text:
maya: Quick ask — Demo on Wed 5PM SGT, need extra GPUs in ap-southeast1 for a load test. Current quota shows 4 A100; we need +6 A100 temporary or fallback to ~12 T4s. Can vendor top-up or expedite quota change? @cloud-vendor-apac

jonathan: How long is the peak window? also need expected cost so procurement can approve. We can attempt routing but need specifics.

maya: Peak ~2h (17:00–19:00 SGT), sustained ~200 concurrent inferences, ~60k tokens/min. A100 preferred for latency; T4s acceptable if we get more of them.

cloud-vendor-apac: We can request a provisional quota bump but we need a PO number and account_id. We can provisionally bump up to +8 A100 for 24h pending PO authorization. ETA ~6 hours after we have the PO and account_id.

sophie: Procurement here — we can issue a PCard for up to $7k today. @maya please DM the estimated spend and account_id so I can start the vendor flow.

devops-bot: Quota snapshot (generated): ap-southeast1: A100 quota=4, used=3; T4 quota=32, used=18; reserved_pools=0.

rahul: If the vendor can’t get us 6 A100s in time, fallback plan: route to eu-west1 pool and accept +~70ms p99. We can also prewarm a smaller model variant to lower peak GPU need.

maya: Ok — I’ll DM cost + account_id. Need vendor confirmation before 12:00 SGT today to avoid switching to fallback.

jonathan: I’ll draft a minimal routing rule and canary config for the cross-region fallback. @rahul can you put together the quick runbook for the switch?

cloud-vendor-apac: Ticket created #46298. Provisional bump queued; please provide account_id and authorizing email so we can proceed. Finalization expected 6–8h after PO.

sophie: Sent PCard approval to maya via DM. Please confirm the final estimate and the account_id in the DM thread.

maya: Sent details (account_id + estimate). Thanks everyone — will update here when vendor confirms or if we flip to fallback. :thumbsup:
